changes: Adapted the source video/time-lapse direction into a single still-photo composition, appropriate for this photoshoot-template folder; no unsafe content was present.

project_info.theme: soft cinematic adult hand-embroidery still life
project_info.color_palette: pastel pink, ivory, pale peach, warm wood, and diffuse white light

main_subject.description: An adult craftsperson's hands carefully pulling pale-pink thread through a small floral embroidery pattern.
main_subject.wardrobe: Ivory cotton blouse sleeve with delicate cuff detail; hands wear only simple unbranded rings.
main_subject.action: Needle is mid-stitch above an embroidery hoop, with the nearly completed flower visible in the fabric.

composition_elements.framing: Intimate close-up of hands, needle, thread, and hoop, with the completed floral motif occupying the lower third.
composition_elements.environment: Clean sunlit craft table, soft pastel textile scraps, and no readable pattern labels, packaging, or text.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft backlighting through a sheer curtain with gentle side fill, shallow depth of field, and delicate highlight on thread fibers.

technical_specs.camera: 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field
technical_specs.quality: high-detail thread fibers, natural hands, subtle film grain, soft pastel color grade

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 intimate cinematic macro still life of an adult craftsperson's hands embroidering a small pale-pink floral motif. Show an ivory cotton blouse cuff, simple unbranded rings, a needle mid-stitch, fine pink thread, and a wooden embroidery hoop with the nearly completed flower visible. Place the hoop on a clean sunlit craft table with softly blurred pastel textile scraps. Use soft backlight through a sheer curtain, gentle side fill, 100mm macro shallow depth of field, detailed thread fibers, natural hands, subtle film grain, and a delicate pastel color grade. No labels, packaging, readable text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, video frame, storyboard, time-lapse sequence, readable pattern text, packaging, logo, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, harsh lighting

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All references are optional. Use them only to replace hoop, floral stitch pattern, fabric palette, or window-light character; remove all labels and text.

assets.usage: Replace flower stitch structure and thread colors without readable pattern text.
